support.heroTitle: Help for profile and mobile settings
support.contactUsersBody: Call us for quick questions about your account and the app

support.chatNote: * Average chat response time is under 5 minutes.
support.ticketNote: * Replies to reported issues arrive within 24 hours.

1.q: How do I update profile information?
1.a: On the Edit profile screen you can change your first name, last name, phone number, country and profile photo using the existing account options.

2.q: Where can I see my favorites?
2.a: The Favorites screen shows every item saved through the current API and lets you quickly remove anything you no longer need.

3.q: How does the trip planner work?
3.a: The planner currently works locally on the device and does not require backend changes. You can save a destination, date, notes and a checklist.

4.q: How do I change the app language?
4.a: On the Language screen you can choose a supported language and save the change through the user route. The change is reflected immediately in the mobile interface.

about.quote: "Our mission is to give every traveler an authentic experience of Montenegro, from hidden southern beaches to untouched mountain peaks in the north."

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.heroTitle: What the mobile app currently stores and shows.
privacy.heroBody: This screen gives a clear overview of the data used by the frontend and the current limitations until the backend gets additional functionality.

1.title: Account data
1.body: The mobile frontend currently shows basic account data such as first name, last name, email, phone number, country and profile photo.

2.title: Locally stored data
2.body: Trip planner data and interests can be stored locally on the device without sending new data to the backend.

3.title: How to request a change
3.body: If you want a data correction or additional explanation, use the Help and support screen or the contact address listed in the app.

note.1: The frontend does not manage account deletion or data export without backend support.
note.2: Profile photo updates and basic profile edits use the existing API routes that are already available.
note.3: Sensitive account actions require additional backend support and permissions.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.heroTitle: A clear summary of the rules for the mobile app.
terms.heroBody: This screen gives a frontend overview of the most important usage rules until the full legal version is aligned across the system.

1.title: Using the app
1.body: The mobile frontend lets you browse destinations, objects, favorites and personal settings. The user is responsible for the accuracy of the data entered on the account.

2.title: Content and information
2.body: Displayed data depends on available API responses. The frontend shows what the backend currently returns and does not guarantee additional features that are not supported by system routes.

3.title: Account and security
3.body: Logout, basic profile edits and photo changes use existing account mechanisms. Additional account actions require dedicated backend support.

note.1: Favorites, reviews and profile data are tied to the currently signed-in account.
note.2: The locally stored planner works only on the device where it was created.
note.3: Legal and production versions of the terms still need to be aligned with the team and the backend specification.
